# @voltarenyah/dsh-prompt-note

A Session-bound “pending prompts” list for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), rendered as a
tab in the **right

sidebar**. Write the next prompt down while the agent is
still working on the current turn, then sen

d it — one at a time — when you are
ready.
## Compatibility

Requires DSH **≥ 0.2.1-rc.2** — the release that ships the right-sidebar tab
registry (`ctx.sidebarR

ightTabs`) this plugin registers into. The requirement is
declared as `engines.dsh`, so an older Hos

t refuses the installation instead of
failing at runtime.
## Install

- **In the app:** sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then enter the package
name `@voltarenyah/

dsh-prompt-note` (or a pinned
`@voltarenyah/dsh-prompt-note@0.1.2`) and install.
- **With an agent:*

* ask it to install the bundle `@voltarenyah/dsh-prompt-note`.
- **From the CLI:** `dsh plugin --pro
file <profile> add @voltarenyah/dsh-prompt-note`.

Installs go to the *profile*, so every Session in that profile gets the tab. If
your package manager

points at a mirror that has not synced the release yet, ask
for npm's own registry explicitly (in t

he app: the plugin manager's registry
choice; from the CLI: `--registry https://registry.npmjs.org/`

app: the plugin manager's registry
choice; from the CLI: `--registry https://registry.npmjs.org/`).
## Why

The composer queue belongs to the running turn: anything typed while the agent
works is queued for *

that* turn. But mid-conversation you often produce ideas
that belong to a **later** turn, and you ar

e not yet sure whether this turn will
continue debugging. Writing them into the queue is wrong, and

keeping them in
your head or in a scratch buffer loses them.
`dsh-prompt-note` keeps them next to the conversation they belong to.
## What it does

- **One list per Session.** Notes are keyed by Session id, stored by the Host
half in the profile's

data directory (`<profile>/dsh-prompt-note/notes.json`),
so they survive page reloads, restarts, and

other clients.
- **Write, edit, delete.** Compose box at the top (`Ctrl+Enter` adds), inline
edit p

er note, `Escape` cancels.
- **Send when ready.** `Send` admits the stored note as the Session's nex

t
prompt through the Host's Session controller (`mode: 'queue'`), so a running
turn queues it exactl

y like a typed prompt. The note is consumed on success.
No composer draft is touched — sending from

the panel never overwrites text
you were already typing.
- **Locales.** English and Chinese copy; fo
llows the app's active locale.
## Where to find it

Open the right sidebar (the panel toggle at the top right), then either pick
**Pending prompts** fro

m the empty-state list or use the sidebar's **+** (new
tab) control. The tab is per-Session: switchi
ng conversations switches the list.
## Files
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: the notes store and the fenced `/prompt-note/api/*` route (`list`, `add`,

`update`, `remove`, `consume`, `clear`, `send`). |
| `client.js` | Client half: registers the right-

sidebar tab type and its body; renders the panel. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts

the `prompt-note` row. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin display metadata (title, des

cription). |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin artwork. |
## Route contract

All methods are `POST` with a JSON body and answer `{ ok: true, value }` or
`{ ok: false, error: { c

ode, message } }`. The route is fenced with the Host's
browser-trust check (`connection.requestRejec

ssage } }`. The route is fenced with the Host's
browser-trust check (`connection.requestRejection`).
| Method | Body | Value |

| `list` | `{ sessionId }` | `{ notes: Note[] }` |
| `add` | `{ sessionId, text }` | `{ note }` |
|

`update` | `{ sessionId, id, text }` | `{ note }` |
| `remove` | `{ sessionId, id }` | `{ removed: b

oolean }` |
| `clear` | `{ sessionId }` | `{ cleared: number }` |
| `send` | `{ sessionId, id }` | `

ear` | `{ sessionId }` | `{ cleared: number }` |
| `send` | `{ sessionId, id }` | `{ sent: true }` |
A note is `{ id, text, createdAt, updatedAt }`.
## Limits

- 20 000 characters per note, 200 notes per Session.
- The list is not pushed live to other open cli

ents; use the reload control in
the panel header.
